question: What is the antonym of "Parsimonious"?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Generous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"parsimonious"** means unwilling to spend money or use resources; stingy or frugal. (कंजूस/मितव्ययी)
 
 
• **Example:** The parsimonious man refused to donate even a small amount to the charity.
 
 
• The word **"generous"** refers to someone who is willing to give more of something, especially money or time, than is strictly necessary or expected. (उदार)
 
 
• **Example:** She is known for her generous donations to educational institutions.
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of "parsimonious" is "generous."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Generous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Stingy** (कंजूस): Unwilling to give or spend; ungenerous.
 
 
• **Example:** He is so stingy that he hesitates to tip the waiter even a small amount.
 
 
 
• **Frugal** (मितव्ययी): Sparing or economical with regard to money or food.
 
 
• **Example:** She led a frugal lifestyle to save money for her children's education.
 
 
 
• **Economical** (आर्थिक): Using no more of something than is necessary; efficient.
 
 
• **Example:** Buying in bulk is an economical way to save money on groceries.
